claim_boundary: This R3 fail-closed preseal verifies protected identities, procedural allowlists, cfg(test)-only wiring, ratified P33 behavior, attributable RED, P1430, exact 28-ID order determinism, mechanical checks and causal M14/M27 design. It records the remaining executable-coverage and M16 discrimination blockers only. It emits no seal, no final verdict, no mutation-score claim, no implementation authorization, no general Typst parity claim, and no workspace or conversational isolation attestation.
